735060101.text: Greetings! Welcome to the Citadel of Regzar. Would you be interested in taking on some commissions?

735060102.text: Are there any easy jobs where we can earn loads of Mora for just standing around? Oh, better yet, for sitting around! That's the kind of task we're interested in now.

735060103.text: Uh, ahem... We don't currently have any commissions like that. However, I do have some relatively simple requests from residents that will pay several thousand Mora.

735060104.text: Really, that's all? That isn't nearly enough for Paimon.

735060107.text: Yeah. Effendi, are there any high-paying commissions available?

735060108.text: Ah, I see. Let me think... Spantamad recently initiated a research project on the Ley Lines and is looking for paid volunteers.

735060109.text: There are several researchers in Spantamad who specialize in studying Ley Lines, so there is a great demand for Ley Lines data. Researchers often need to enter Domains to investigate Ley Line Disorders.

735060110.text: They have been understaffed for some time, even after recruiting a good number of their own students. So now they've turned to recruiting large numbers of volunteers.

735060111.text: They offer substantial pay, but they also have strict requirements for the quality of the volunteers. Are you interested?

735060113.text: Yes, let's walk through the recruitment process... First of all, "are you proficient with one or more types of weapon?"

735062301.text: What a pity. It's very rare for us to meet like this.

735062303.text: Oh? Then would you like to spend some time with me, darling? That would be wonderful.

735062305.text: I plan to spend the next few days visiting around Sumeru City. At the end of my stay, I'll leave from Gandharva Ville and return to Mondstadt via Liyue.

735062306.text: Who knows, perhaps we'll bump into each other again in Sumeru City or Gandharva Ville.

735062307.text: Hmm, come to think of it, there's something romantic about such a chance encounter like this. It's like icing on the cake for this little vacation of mine.

735062308.text: If you see me around, be sure to come and say hello, otherwise I might start feeling lonely, hehe.

735060301.text: There you are! Looks like you two are ready.

735060303.text: Very well. Let me inform you of some details.

735060304.text: Spantamad has been involved with the Ley Lines for a long time, and it's imperative that their current is constantly monitored. This research project was also organized to help meet this demand.

735060305.text: However, because abnormal fluctuations often occur in Sumeru Domains, we must regularly send people deep into various Domains to record the situation with the Ley Lines.

735060306.text: Since it's often dangerous inside the Domains, we've established a rule of only dispatching personnel with combat capabilities.

735060307.text: It'll be your task to go into the Domain and record any Ley Line anomalies. However, if you encounter any danger, please prioritize your safety.

735060308.text: Well, those are all the necessary details. When you're ready, you may enter the Domain.

735060201.text: Do you still remember what the coffee's like here?

735060202.text: Of course, how could I forget? It used to be my go-to drink here.

735060203.text: Listen, Gafoor... Ahem, I suppose I should call you Professor Gafoor now... We're old acquaintances, so how about we stop beating around the bush, hmm?

735060204.text: First you wanted to catch up, and now the coffee... If you have something to say, just say it.

735060205.text: Oh, that's Gafoor. He's the one we're searching for, but he seems to be busy talking with someone else. Maybe we should wait for them to finish.

735060206.text: Oh, well it's nothing, really. It's just that ever since you left the Akademiya, our original projects and plans have lost their backbone, so to speak.

735060207.text: Cyrus is also disappointed. He's always valued you as a proud disciple.

735060208.text: To be honest, it's a real shame that you left the Akademiya, Lisa.

735060209.text: With your wisdom and intellect, had you stayed in the Akademiya, you would have become a Herbad by now.

735060212.text: Hold on... That's Lisa! The librarian Lisa! Our Lisa!

735060213.text: Paimon heard that Lisa had studied at the Akademiya before, but that was a long time ago. What's Lisa doing here now?

735060214.text: If I'm reading the situation right, you're reminiscing about the past to convince me to come back, aren't you?

735060215.text: Well, I heard that you're currently the librarian for the Knights of Favonius in Mondstadt. If you ask me, that's a tragic waste of your talents.

735060216.text: Why waste your time and energy on something as trivial as taking care of a library? Your time is much more valuable than that.

735060217.text: If you're willing to come back to the Akademiya, I have plenty of projects for you to preside over right away. The Akademiya needs people right now, and some of these projects are quite important...

735060218.text: Yawn... So all this talk IS to convince me to come back. I'm guessing Professor Cyrus doesn't know that you're talking to me about this.

735060219.text: As a matter of fact, he has long wanted you to come back and work at the Akademiya.

735060220.text: ...Is that so? You know, Professor Gafoor, it isn't a good idea to lie to people.

735060221.text: Our teacher knows exactly why I left the Akademiya after only two years. He would never ask me to come back.

735060222.text: Giving up my life in Mondstadt and returning to the Akademiya as a Spantamad researcher... The price of seeking wisdom is no longer something I'm willing to pay.

735060223.text: So please, don't bother trying to get me to come back.

735060224.text: Wow, so Lisa used to be a Spantamad researcher? Paimon's never heard her mention it before.

735060401.text: I remember you two agreed to meet Gafoor in Mawtiyima Forest to talk about the Ley Lines research job.

735060402.text: Feel free to leave if you want to go look for him. As for me, I think I'll spend a little more time at Puspa Café.

735062101.text: I see... Even I didn't expect them to be so bent on their pursuit, wanting to even surpass the gods...

735062102.text: Sounds like you were involved in some remarkable events again, and I was completely unaware.

735062103.text: And to think you were even able to handle a crisis of that magnitude... Cutie, your abilities are really beyond measure.

735062104.text: Having accomplished such a feat, I'm sure you must have a lot on your plate right now. I was actually thinking about inviting you two to walk around Sumeru with me...

735062201.text: I see... So you came to Sumeru in search of information on Lesser Lord Kusanali, the God of Wisdom.

735062202.text: The two of you have more pressing issues than entertaining a tourist like me.

735062203.text: I wanted to walk around Sumeru with you, but now doesn't seem like the right time.
